title: The Pariksha Protocol: Verifiable Custody and Conduct for Examinations (Working Draft 01)
description: An open specification for conducting public examinations such that every artifact is a verifiable credential, every act is bound to an identified participant under explicit expiring authority, and every event is witnessed on a tamper-evident ledger. Delivery-agnostic and implementation-agnostic. Released for public comment and independent stewardship; submitted to India's High-Powered Task Force on Reforms in Public Examinations, August 2026.
